sentences.text: It is submitted by learned counsel for the applicants that in this case applicant no. 1 is wife of opposite party no. 2 and applicant nos. 2, 3 are father and mother.

It is further submitted that on 16.02.2022 marriage of applicant no. 1 was solemnized with opposite party, but on account of matrimonial dispute she was beaten by the opposite party no. 2 regarding which she lodged an F.I.R. under Section 498A, 323, 506 and 3/4 Dowry Prohibition Act against the opposite party no. 2 and other members of his family.
In counter-blast of that F.I.R. present complaint has been filed with false allegations by the opposite party no. 2 against the applicants.
The allegations made in complaint are totally false.
She never made any pressure on the opposite party no. 2 to send his mother in old age home but she herself subjected her to harassment for demand of dowry.

It is also submitted that the statements of opposite party no. 2 and other relative witnesses were recorded before the learned trial court under Section 200 and 202 Cr.P.C. on the basis of which they have been summoned under Sections 504 and 406 I.P.C.

It is also submitted that the present complaint was filed with intention to make harassment of the applicants, therefore, request to quash the entire proceedings of the case including the summoning order passed by the learned trial court on 29.04.2024.
Learned A.G.A. has opposed the prayer as aforesaid.

On considering the facts and circumstances of the case, submissions made by learned counsel for the applicants as well as learned A.G.A., perusal of record, the contents of F.I.R., the statements of complainant and other witnesses as recorded under Sections 200 and 202 Cr.P.C., it appears that the veracity of statements made by the complainant and other witnesses cannot be examined at this stage but it is possible only during the course of trial.
As a result, prayer for quashing the entire proceedings of the case including the summoning order passed by the learned trial court on 29.04.2024 is hereby refused.

Further, applicants may have an option to move an application for discharge before the learned trial court at an appropriate stage which shall be heard and decided in accordance with law on the basis of material on record.
Accordingly, this application stands disposed of finally.

Order Date :- 13.8.2024 Suraj Srivastav  Smt Pooja And 2 Others vs State Of U.P. And Another on 13 August, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/38968106/
